title: Train Puzzle
description: Connect the tracks to guide the train safely to its destination.
about:
Train Puzzle is a browser game where you select a difficulty and rearrange the track tiles to guide the train to the finish.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Select a difficulty and rearrange the track tiles to guide the train to the finish.
tips: Use click / tap tiles to swap track pieces.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Train Puzzle?
faq.answer: Select a difficulty and rearrange the track tiles to guide the train to the finish.

faq.question: Can I play Train Puzzle in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
